questions.question: After Korah, Dathan and Abiram rebelled against Moses, what happened to them and their households when Moses finished speaking?

answers.text: The earth opened and swallowed them
A flood swept their tents away
A storm tore their tents down

questions.question: Moses told Korah and the Levites that God had already brought them near. What else were they seeking?

answers.text: A bigger share of the offerings

questions.question: When Korah's 250 followers stood offering incense during the rebellion against Moses, what happened to them?

answers.text: Fire from the LORD consumed them
A plague from the LORD struck them
They were driven out of the camp

questions.question: When a plague spread through Israel after Korah's rebellion, where did Aaron stand with his incense?

answers.text: Between the living and the dead
Beside the altar inside the Tent
At the far edge of the camp
